name: Beautifly
description: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid to inflict damage. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.
